tools.name: segment_get_workspace
tools.description: Get the Segment workspace this token belongs to (id, name, slug). Good first call to confirm the connection and the region. Public API: GET /.

tools.name: segment_list_sources
tools.description: List the sources in the workspace: each source's id, name, slug, enabled flag, write keys and metadata (the catalog type). Public API: GET /sources.

tools.name: segment_get_source
tools.description: Get one source by id: its settings, labels, enabled flag and write keys. Public API: GET /sources/{sourceId}.

tools.name: segment_list_source_destinations
tools.description: List the destinations connected to one source: each connection's id, name, enabled flag and metadata. Public API: GET /sources/{sourceId}/connected-destinations.

tools.name: segment_list_destinations
tools.description: List the destinations in the workspace: each destination's id, enabled flag, sourceId and metadata (the catalog type). Public API: GET /destinations.

tools.name: segment_get_destination
tools.description: Get one destination by id: its settings, enabled flag, the source it is connected to and its metadata. Public API: GET /destinations/{destinationId}.

tools.name: segment_list_tracking_plans
tools.description: List the tracking plans in the workspace: each plan's id, name, type and last update time. Public API: GET /tracking-plans.

tools.name: segment_get_tracking_plan
tools.description: Get one tracking plan by id: its name, description, type and timestamps. Public API: GET /tracking-plans/{trackingPlanId}.

tools.name: segment_list_warehouses
tools.description: List the warehouses connected to the workspace: each warehouse's id, name, type and status. Public API: GET /warehouses.

tools.name: segment_get_warehouse
tools.description: Get one warehouse by id: its settings, type and status. Public API: GET /warehouses/{warehouseId}.

tools.name: segment_list_warehouse_sources
tools.description: List the sources connected to one warehouse: each source's id, name and sync settings. Public API: GET /warehouses/{warehouseId}/connected-sources.
